name: ARTEMIS
summary: Advanced Robotic Technology for Enhanced Mobility and Improved Stability — a bipedal robot from Dennis Hong's RoMeLa lab (now at UCLA) with custom proprioceptive actuators that behave like springy muscles. ARTEMIS can run, was measured walking at 2.1 m/s, resists hard shoves, and was built to play soccer at RoboCup.
notable: Custom force-controlled actuators emulating biological muscle
Among the few academic humanoids that can run

sources.title: UCLA Newsroom — ARTEMIS gets ready for action
